frame: north=-z, east=+x, bearing=atan2(dx,-dz), right=(-cos b, sin b)

holes.name: Rakt uppför
holes.note: Inte långt, men rakt uppför – 26 meter upp till green – och tillräckligt för ett spännande andraslag där höjdskillnaden gör längden svår att bedöma. Greenen består av två platåer; sikta på dess breda mitt, för vänster om green krävs ett Mickelson-slag. Svårt, men roligt.
holes.guideGreen: Large oval cross-hatched green at the top-left of the plan, its long axis running roughly from lower-right to upper-left (angled to the line of play). It sits on a raised plateau with a distinct collar/surround and a mown apron ramping up to it from the right/front-right; the approach feeds in from the right side of the fairway. No greenside bunkers are visible in this rendering, and no water near the green. A "Next Tee" arrow sign stands in the right-rear of the green complex with a path leading away right.
holes.guideTrees: Heavily treed both sides. The left side is a dense, continuous belt of tall deciduous trees and pines running from about the tee level all the way to the green, tight to the fairway edge. The right side has scattered trees near the forward tees and a thicker band of pines/spruce beyond the road from about mid-hole onward. Behind and left of the green is a solid stand of tall pines closing off the back of the hole.
holes.shape: gentle dogleg right; tree-lined down the left, bunkers right of the fairway, elevated green tucked against the forest
holes.orientation: Back tees sit at the bottom of the plan (the 65/61/58/55 boxes stacked low-left, then 48, then the forward 40 tee just short of the fairway), and play runs UP the image to the green at the top-left. The compass rose top-right is small and dark but legible: its N arrow points DOWN and slightly LEFT (S sits up-right, E left, W right), so up-the-image is roughly south — the hole plays approximately southward, tee to green.

holes.name: Eaglechansen
holes.note: Rondens bästa chans till birdie, kanske eagle. Hålet faller 48 meter: lägg upp på platån före sluttningen, som Peter Forsberg ibland gör med en järnåtta, så blir andraslaget in mot green enkelt. Out of bounds till vänster, tjock ruff till höger.
holes.guideGreen: Large kidney/comma-shaped cross-hatched putting surface set in the upper-left of the plan, angled across the line of play. It is broadest at the back-left and tapers to a narrower tail at the front-right, with a collar of lighter surround and a run-off/approach opening from the front-left. The only sand near it is the small round bunker off the front-right. A "Next Tee" flag/arrow sits just right of the green pointing right, and the white OB/fence line runs immediately behind it.
holes.guideTrees: Very heavily treed. A dense wall of dark conifers and mixed hardwoods lines the entire left side from the tees all the way to the green, tight to the fairway edge in places and separating the hole from the OB line. The right side has a thinner but continuous belt of trees (birches/pines) along the rough, thickening around the lay-up zone where it screens the stream. Isolated trees stand between the tee boxes and along the tee-to-fairway walk, and a small clump of dark trees sits just short-left of the green. Rough/rocky grey waste ground shows between the tees and the start of the fairway.
holes.shape: long par 5, slight dogleg right, narrow forest-lined corridor the whole way, steeply downhill
holes.orientation: Standard reading: the six tee boxes are at the BOTTOM of the plan (65 lowest and furthest back at bottom-left, then 61 and 58 just above it, 55 a little higher and right, 40/48 highest of the group) and the green is at the TOP, so "up the image" is down the hole. The compass rose sits top-right of the plan and is rotated: its N label/arrow points to the lower-right of the frame (roughly 4-5 o'clock), with S pointing left, W upper-right and E lower-left. That makes screen-up (the direction of play) roughly west-south-west; the rose is very dark and low-contrast, so treat the exact bearing as approximate.

holes.name: Ett av de svåraste
holes.note: Definitivt ett av banans svåraste hål: 23 meter uppför, med en rad bunkrar längs vänstersidan och ett dike längs den högra. Inspelet mot en upphöjd green som lutar åt vänster ner mot en bunker kräver precision – säkrast är att missa kort om greenen, och väl uppe är den svårputtad.
holes.guideGreen: Large pale cross-hatched green at the top of the plan, roughly rectangular with rounded corners and slightly wider than deep, set a little left of the fairway's centre line and raised above an apron of fairway-cut approach. A single comma/kidney-shaped bunker guards its front-left; a "Next Tee" signpost stands in the rough further left, with the OB fence line behind.
holes.guideTrees: Heavy woodland frames both sides for the full length. On the right a dense continuous belt of conifers and birch sits between the fairway edge and the stream, thickening opposite the green. On the left, scattered mature trees and a broken wood line run from the tee area up to about three-quarters, with a couple of prominent specimen trees near the greenside bunker and the Next Tee path. The fairway corridor itself is clear.
holes.shape: slight dogleg right; bunkers down the left of the fairway and one front-left of the green, wooded ridge right
holes.orientation: Back tee (65) at the bottom of the plan, slightly left of centre, with the tee cluster 65/61/58/55 lowest, the 48 tee above them and the 40 tee further up on the right edge of the fairway; the green is at the top of the plan, so play runs up the image. The compass rose (right side, level with the green) has its N arrow pointing up-and-to-the-left (toward the frame's top-left corner), with E up-right, S down-right, W down-left — so the rose is turned about 45 degrees and the hole plays roughly north-east on the ground.

holes.name: Håll vänster
holes.note: Korthål nedför med out of bounds längs högerkanten, en bunker som vaktar greenens högra sida och ett dike till vänster. Greenens lutning gör det svårt att få stopp på bollen: håll till vänster, sikta förbi flaggan och våga gå för green – bollen stannar bäst om den landar på den.
holes.guideGreen: Large, broad kidney/heart-shaped green whose long axis lies across the line of play (left-to-right as seen from the tee), roughly twice as wide as it is deep. The right side pinches into a distinct waist where the big right-hand bunker cuts in, leaving a smaller back-right lobe; a tongue of green (or closely mown apron) runs forward off the front-centre/front-left toward the fairway. The surface appears to sit on a slightly raised plateau with fall-off short-right; no clear tiering or slope shading is legible in this dark screenshot, and no pin dot is visible on the surface. A "Next Tee" flag sits off the back-right of the green.
holes.guideTrees: Continuous mixed birch/deciduous treeline down the entire left side, sitting just outside the red dashed line and pressing close to the fairway from about 0.2 upward; it wraps across the top behind the green. On the right, a dense clump of tall dark pines stands in the right rough from roughly 0.1 to 0.35, immediately beside the tees, and is the main corridor pinch — the gap between those pines and the left trees is the narrowest point, right off the tee. Beyond about 0.45 the right side opens into wide rough falling away to a dark slope, with only scattered trees at the top right. A single dark pine also stands left of the forward tees. Mid-fairway at roughly 0.75 there is a small grey boulder/rock with a shadow near the centre line — not sand.
holes.shape: straight par 3, green flanked by bunkers left and right, sandy waste down the right
holes.orientation: The six tee boxes sit at the bottom of the plan (65 furthest back at bottom-right, then 61 to its left, and 58/55/48/40 stacked ahead of them) and the green is at the top, so play runs up the image, bottom to top. The compass rose at lower left is rotated: N points toward the lower right of the frame, S to the upper left, W to the upper right, E to the lower left. Up-image (the line of play) therefore runs roughly southwest-to-west-southwest, i.e. north is behind and to the player's right.

holes.name: Strategiskt andraslag
holes.note: Håll en aning höger med utslaget – sluttningen tar bollen tillbaka till fairway. Andraslaget är strategiskt: flirta med bunkern på vänstersidan för ett enkelt tredjeslag, för från höger är greenen som lutar åt vänster svår att hålla. Håll vänster och bli belönad.
holes.guideGreen: Large pear/oval-shaped green sitting slightly left of the fairway centreline, its long axis running with the line of play (front-to-back). The surface is rendered as a pale cross-hatched patch with a lighter left/centre portion and a slightly darker collar on the right, hinting at a fall to the right, but the image is too dark to read tiering reliably. No red or yellow pin dot is visible on the green in this screenshot (the small red, yellow and white dots further down the fairway are distance markers). A "Next Tee" flag sits off the left-rear corner of the green.
holes.guideTrees: Dense continuous treeline down the entire left side, tight against the fairway edge from the tees to just short of the green, with a cart path and a further band of trees beyond it - the left is fully enclosed. On the right the trees are lighter: a scattered line beside the tee boxes, then a gap through the mid-fairway where the right side is open rough, with one prominent dark conifer plus a small clump intruding at about 0.75-0.8 that pinches the right edge of the corridor. A solid belt of trees closes off the far end behind the green. The narrowest points are the tee-shot chute out of the tee complex (0.05-0.15) and the right-side tree intrusion around 0.75-0.8.
holes.shape: long par 5, essentially straight with a faint left bow; dense forest hard down the left, bunkers around the green
holes.orientation: Back tee (65) at the bottom of the plan, on the right-hand side of the tee complex; green at the top. Play therefore runs up the image. The compass rose top-left reads N at the top, E to the right, so north points up the frame (roughly straight up, maybe a few degrees tilted) and the hole plays broadly south to north. The six tee boxes are stacked bottom-right to bottom-centre: 65 lowest, then 61 and 58 side by side just above it, then 55, then 48 further up and left, with the forward 40 tee well up the fairway on the left-centre.

holes.name: Diket
holes.note: Index 2 och en dogleg vänster där den långtslående ställs inför ett delikat val: lägg upp kort om diket som delar fairway, eller slå över det. Går du över, sikta på fairways vänstra sida – närmaste vägen över och bästa inspelsvinkeln. En damm vaktar framför green till höger.
holes.guideGreen: Cross-hatched pale putting surface in the top-left of the plan, kidney/boomerang shaped with a distinct notch bitten out of its right-hand flank, so the right side is split into a front-right and a back-right lobe. The long axis runs roughly along the line of play (deep front-to-back rather than wide), tilted so the back of the green leans to the right of the frame. A pale fringe/collar rings it. Mowing shading hints at a slight fall from back-right to front-left but the image is too dark to call any tiering with confidence. No pin dot is visible on the green in this screenshot — the small red, yellow and white ovals further down are fairway distance markers, not pin positions. A "Next Tee" arrow points away to the back-left of the green.
holes.guideTrees: A dense, unbroken belt of dark conifers and mixed trees runs down the entire LEFT side of the plan, from beside the back tees all the way past the green, and it presses in tightest along the second fairway and the left of the green (about 0.65-1.0), where the corridor is squeezed between that treeline on the left and the creek/right-hand lake on the right. A small group of trees stands at the top-right beyond the green near the stream inlet, and one or two isolated trees sit on the right by the cart path near the forward tees; otherwise the right side is open water and rough rather than timber. A few scattered trees also stand right around the tee boxes at the bottom.
holes.shape: par 4 bending right between two ponds - water left off the tee, larger pond right of the approach; fjord beyond the left
holes.orientation: Back tee at the BOTTOM of the plan (the 65 box sits bottom-left, with 61, then 55/58, then 48 and 40 stepping up and to the right), green at the TOP-LEFT — so play runs up the image. A compass rose sits at the left edge of the plan, in the treeline about level with the landing zone; only two letters are legible on this dark screenshot, "S" at the lower-left of the circle and "E" at its lower-right, which puts north toward the UPPER-RIGHT of the frame (play therefore running roughly north/north-north-west). The rose is small and dim, so treat the north reading as approximate.

holes.name: Räcker klubban?
holes.note: Ett beskedligt korthål vid första anblicken, men svårare än det ser ut. Välj en klubba som verkligen räcker ända fram till den något upphöjda greenen: en bunker sveper sig runt greenens vänstersida och en annan vaktar dess främre del.
holes.guideGreen: Large, broad green, roughly kidney/heart-shaped, with its long axis running left-to-right across the line of play (noticeably wider than it is deep). There is a distinct notch or pinch in the near-left edge where the left greenside bunker pushes in, giving a smaller front-left lobe and a bigger right-hand body. The surround shows a raised shelf/collar all round, suggesting a slightly elevated pad, but no clear tiering or slope detail can be read. No pin dot is legible in this screenshot. A "Next Tee" flag sits off the back-left of the green.
holes.guideTrees: Heavy tree cover both sides of the tee: a dense block of tall conifers and deciduous trees immediately left of the back tee box, and a large spruce standing right beside the tees on their right, plus a birch/mixed treeline down the right edge from the tee up to about two-thirds of the hole. Scattered trees follow the stream up the left side and a further clump of trees stands right of the green. The corridor is at its narrowest around the tee and the stream crossing (roughly 0.3-0.5); it opens out into a wide green complex for the last third.
holes.shape: short straight par 3 over heathland; big bunker front-left of the green, second bunker short right
holes.orientation: Back tee at the bottom of the plan (centre, slightly right of centre), green at the top slightly left of centre, so play runs up the image. The four back tees (65, 61, 58, 55) sit on one long tee box at the very bottom; the two forward tees (48, 40) are on a separate box roughly a third of the way up. The compass rose sits at the top right: north points up and to the left (roughly NNW in image terms), so the hole plays approximately north to north-northeast.

holes.name: Generöst utslag
holes.note: Landningsytan är förhållandevis generös, så dra på – men undvik bunkern på vänster sida. Vinden gör stor skillnad här, och inspelet mot den snedställda greenen är inte enkelt: för kort och bollen hamnar i greenbunkern.
holes.guideGreen: A large boomerang / kidney-shaped green with the cross-hatched putting surface curving around a notch on its front-left. Its long axis lies obliquely to the line of play, running from back-left to front-right, so the target is wide but the front-right lobe is the nearest part to the player and the back-left portion sits well beyond the bunker. The concave inside of the boomerang faces front-left, exactly where the big greenside bunker bites in, so a left pin would sit on a shallow sliver behind sand. The apron/collar is drawn as a broad pale surround with the fairway feeding in from the front-right. I can see no tiering or slope shading on the surface, and no pin dot is visible on the green in this screenshot — the small red and yellow ovals out in the fairway (around 0.62 and 0.55 respectively) carry numbers and are distance markers, not pin positions.
holes.guideTrees: Dense mixed woodland (birch and conifer) lines both sides for the entire hole, forming a fully enclosed corridor. The left treeline is heavy and continuous from the tees to beyond the green, and it steps in noticeably from about 0.5 onwards, with the red penalty line hugging its edge. On the right the woods stand a little further back through the driving zone, leaving a wide band of rough, but they push in sharply at about 0.8–0.9 where the ditch stub comes out, and again around the tees where scattered trees separate the teeing grounds from the right-hand ditch. The tightest point of the corridor is that pinch at roughly 0.85, just short of the green complex; below that the corridor is generous.
holes.shape: dead straight par 4 through a chute of pines on both sides of the driving zone; bunker front-left of the green
holes.orientation: Conventional layout: the six tee boxes are stacked at the BOTTOM of the plan (65/61 lowest, then 58/55, then 40/48 highest and furthest forward) and the green is at the TOP, so play runs straight up the image. The tee spread is very large on the plan — the 40/48 tees sit roughly a third of the way up the drawing from the 65 tee, matching the 365 m vs 254 m table. The compass rose (top right) is rotated and small; as far as I can read it the "N" arrow points toward the lower-left of the frame and "S" toward the upper-right, with what looks like Ö/E upper-left and V/W lower-right — i.e. north is roughly behind the tee and to the left, and play runs approximately south-east. The compass lettering is genuinely small and dark, so treat that bearing as approximate.

holes.name: Vattnet till höger
holes.note: Sikta långt till vänster med drivern, särskilt i medvind, för vattnet ligger till höger. Hålet spelas uppför och inspelet kräver mer klubba än många tror: greenen är upphöjd några meter. Lägg inspelet kort om flaggan – returputtarna är snabba.
holes.guideGreen: A large, rounded pear/egg-shaped green shown as a pale cross-hatched patch, its long axis running roughly along the line of play (marginally taller than wide), broader at the back and tapering to a narrower front that runs into a short raised approach neck. Concentric contour bands around the front and edges suggest the green sits slightly raised with fall-off around it, but no clear tiering can be read at this resolution. No pin dot is visible on the green in this screenshot. The small red and yellow ovals further down the fairway (around 0.63 and 0.55 of the way up) are fairway distance markers, not pin positions. A "Next Tee" flag sits in the left rough level with the back of the green.
holes.guideTrees: The strongest treeline is on the RIGHT: a dense stand of mature trees presses in from about 0.10 to 0.45, squeezing the right side of the tee-shot corridor between the 55/58 and 48 tees and effectively defining a narrow chute off the back tees. Scattered trees also sit right at around 0.05-0.10 near the 61/65 tees, and a small clump near 0.63 on the far right edge. The left side is largely open - rough, a cart path and a scattered tree or two beside the left stream - so the corridor's real pinch is right-hand, low on the hole. From about 0.55 upward both sides open out and trees no longer narrow the hole.
holes.shape: long straight par 4 uphill; string of ponds off to the right of the corridor, green up by the clubhouse
holes.orientation: Standard layout: the six tee boxes are stacked low in the frame (65 and 61 at the very bottom, then 55/58, then 48, then 40 just short of the fairway proper) and the green is at the top, so play runs up the image. The compass rose sits at upper right and is rotated to the diagonals: E points upper-left, S upper-right, N lower-left, W lower-right. North therefore points down-left in the frame, which makes the line of play (straight up the image) roughly south-easterly.

holes.name: Placera andraslaget
holes.note: Två bunkrar på fairways högra sida, kullar till vänster och out of bounds längs hela högersidan – undvik framför allt ruffen. Andraslaget avgör: lägg det på fairways vänstra sida, för greenen vaktas av en stor kulle på höger sida och en bunker till vänster; enklast är att få slå ett fullt tredjeslag med en wedge.
holes.guideGreen: A single pale, kidney/pear-shaped green sitting at the top of the plan, set slightly left of the fairway's final centreline. Its long axis runs roughly along the line of play (bottom-left to top-right), with the wider lobe at the back and a narrower neck at the front, and the right edge scooped in where the surround presses back. Slope/tiering is not legible in this dark screenshot beyond a suggestion that the surface sits raised above the approach with a mown collar all round. No pin dot could be made out on the putting surface. A "Next Tee" flag sign sits on the high ground directly behind the green.
holes.guideTrees: Dense mature woodland lines both sides for the whole hole, so the corridor is a closed tree tunnel throughout. The tightest pinch is right at the tees, where the treeline on the right runs hard along the cart path and squeezes the walk out to the 48 tee. Trees also press in from the left at about 0.75-0.80, where a spur of trees and the stream stub push into the rough, and again around the green: the last 40-50 metres is framed tightly by trees on both sides, with the woodland wrapping round behind the green. A brown scrubby waste/rough strip shows on the right between about 0.45 and 0.65, inside the white line.
holes.shape: longest par 5 on the card, near-straight with a slight right bow; treeline and houses down the right
holes.orientation: The plan is oriented conventionally: the six tee boxes (65, 61, 58, 55, 48, then 40 well forward) sit at the BOTTOM of the plan, stacked bottom-left, and the green is at the TOP. Play therefore runs up the image. The compass rose (right side, roughly level with the middle of the hole) is rotated about 45 degrees clockwise: N points to the upper-right of the frame, W upper-left, S lower-left, E lower-right. Since play runs straight up the frame, the hole plays roughly NORTHWEST.

holes.name: Ser lätt ut
holes.note: Ett kort par 4 som ser busenkelt ut. På utslaget: vatten till vänster och out of bounds-linjen till höger. Fundera på hur du vill spela andraslaget – greenens bakre del är lång och ondulerad, och vissa flaggplaceringar kräver din bästa bollkänsla.
holes.guideGreen: A large, pale cross-hatched green at the top-left of the plan, sitting left of the fairway's axis. It is broadly oval/kidney-shaped with its long axis running roughly diagonally across the line of play (front-right to back-left), so it presents a fairly wide but shallow target from the fairway. No tiering, contour arrows or slope shading are legible at this resolution, and I cannot see a red or yellow pin dot on the green — the only coloured dot visible is a small red spot out in the fairway around 0.72 of the hole, which reads as a distance/target marker rather than a pin. A "Next Tee" flag sits just above and left of the green.
holes.guideTrees: Heavy treelines press in on both sides for the whole hole. The right side is the more continuous: a dense band of trees runs from just above the tees all the way to level with the green, tightening the corridor most noticeably from about 0.6 to 0.9. On the left, trees line the tee chute and then reappear alongside the pond and stream from roughly 0.7 to behind the green. The tightest pinch is the approach zone, roughly 0.75-0.9, where the right treeline and the left-side water/trees squeeze the corridor down before it opens onto the green.
holes.shape: par 4 bending slightly right; long pond down the left alongside the green, further ponds right beyond the road
holes.orientation: Back tees (58/61/65) are at the very bottom of the plan, with the forward tees 55, 48 and 40 stepping up the image; the green is at the top-left. Play therefore runs from bottom to top ("up the image" = down the hole), and the plan is oriented the conventional way. A compass rose sits top-right of the plan, but at this screenshot resolution the pointer is small and dark — it appears to point roughly up/up-left, i.e. north is approximately toward the top of the image (toward the green), but I cannot read it reliably.

holes.name: Inbunkrad green
holes.note: Inte för långt, inte för kort – men vinden är ofta en faktor. Greenen är upphöjd och snällt inbunkrad, så det krävs ett riktigt bra slag: kort eller missriktat rullar bollen med stor sannolikhet ner i någon av bunkrarna. Välj en klubba som räcker fram.
holes.guideGreen: Large, broad kidney/heart-shaped green, cross-hatched pale, set on a raised pad. Its long axis lies mainly ACROSS the line of play (left-right), with a deep notch bitten out of the right side and a lobe of apron extending toward the player at the front-centre. Visible contour banding across the front third suggests a tiered/stepped front that falls away toward the player; the surround falls off sharply on the right into the big crescent bunker. No pin dot is discernible in this screenshot, so pin position cannot be reported.
holes.guideTrees: A dense line of birches and broadleaf trees runs right across the top of the plan, immediately behind the green, backing it completely. More trees continue down the right-hand side beyond the green, standing in a wide band of brown scrub/waste rough that occupies the whole right side of the hole from about 0.3 upward. The left side is open mown grass with only a cart path and a lighter adjacent fairway area — no trees. The corridor is therefore squeezed only from the right and behind, not pinched at any point short of the green.
holes.shape: straight par 3 across sandy heath; bunkers left and right of the green, pond well off to the right
holes.orientation: Back tee at the bottom of the plan (slightly right of centre), green at the top — play runs up the image, essentially bottom to top. The six tee boxes climb up the lower right-centre: 65 and 61 lowest (bottom-left of the tee cluster), then 58 and 55, then 48/40 highest and furthest right. Compass rose top-left is rotated: the N arrow points to the upper RIGHT (roughly 45 degrees), W upper left, S lower left, E lower right — so the line of play (up the image) runs roughly north-west.

holes.name: Banans tuffaste
holes.note: Index 1 och Peter Forsbergs favorithål: en lång dogleg höger ner mot fjärden, med out of bounds till höger. Slå en rak drive så nära bunkern i kröken som möjligt, gärna med en svag fade – det öppnar för ett inspel mot en inbjudande green.
holes.guideGreen: Large kidney/comma-shaped green, its long axis running roughly left-right across the image and so set diagonally across the incoming line, which arrives from the lower left. The right-hand lobe curls forward toward the player around the small greenside bunker, leaving a narrow front-right entrance; the left half is the broader, more open part. Some faint mowing striping is visible but no tiering or slope arrows can be made out at this resolution, and no pin dot is legible on the green itself. The red and yellow dots further back are out on the fairway (around 0.6-0.7) and read as distance markers rather than pin positions.
holes.guideTrees: A continuous, heavy treeline runs the entire right side of the hole, from the tees all the way to the green, and it is the dominant framing feature. It pinches hardest from about 0.35 to 0.75, where the trees push out into the right edge of the fairway just past the two right-hand bunkers, squeezing the corridor and forcing the drive left. On the left, a looser line of trees follows the outer edge from about 0.3 upward, sitting beyond the left stream rather than on the fairway. Several trees and conifers also stand close to the right and rear of the green, tightening the approach from the right, and a scattered stand marks the back-left surround behind the putting surface.
holes.shape: long sweeping dogleg left that curves back right to the green; heavy woodland down the right, fjord beyond
holes.orientation: Back tees (61/65) sit at the bottom-right of the plan, with 55/58, 48 and 40 stepping up and slightly left ahead of them; the green is at the top of the frame, a little right of centre, beside the "Next Tee" sign. Play therefore runs up the image, roughly bottom-right to top. No compass rose is visible anywhere in the plan, so north cannot be read from this screenshot.

holes.name: Signaturhålet
holes.note: Veckefjärdens signaturhål: ett underbart korthål till en halvö ute i fjärden, med green omgiven av vatten. Sidvinden tar tag i bollen när den lämnar trädridåns skydd, och i rak motvind är klubbvalet värt en extra tanke. Ett fantastiskt hål.
holes.guideGreen: A large, broad putting surface rendered as a pale cross-hatched patch. Its long axis runs left-to-right across the image, i.e. roughly perpendicular to the line of play, making it wide but shallow front-to-back. The shape is a rounded kidney/oval with a notch bitten out of the front-left, where the bunker sits. Concentric contour bands ring the surface and the surrounding green complex, reading as a raised, crowned/plateau green that falls away on all sides — steepest off the back and right edges straight into the lake. No pin dot (red or yellow) is legible on the surface in this screenshot. A small line of dark stones/rip-rap edges the green complex on its left side where it meets the water, and a 'Next Tee' path label sits on the neck of turf front-left of the green.
holes.guideTrees: Heavy treeline down the LEFT side, running from about 0.1 up to roughly 0.55 — a dense mixed stand of dark conifers and lighter birch that presses right up against the cart path and squeezes the left edge of the corridor. A second, thinner screen of tall trees stands on the RIGHT of the teeing ground, from about 0.0 to 0.25, and one isolated tree sits just left of the tees. The corridor is at its tightest through the tee area and the first third (roughly 0.05-0.3), where trees frame both sides. From about 0.55 onward there are no trees at all — the left side becomes open rough/waste ground and the right side is water, so the shot to the green flies over completely open terrain.
holes.shape: par 3 all-carry across the fjord to an island green on a promontory, water on three sides
holes.orientation: Back tee at the bottom of the plan (a stacked column of pale tee rectangles labelled, from front to back, 48 / 55 / 58 / 61 / 65, with a separate forward tee marked 40 well up the plan near the stream). The green sits at the top-centre, so play runs up the image. Line of play is essentially straight up the frame, with the green only a fraction left of the tee column. The compass rose (top right) is rotated 180 degrees: N points DOWN the image, S up, E to the left, W to the right — so play is roughly southward, and the lake lies to the south/west of the green.

holes.name: Valmöjligheterna
holes.note: Kort par 4 med fjärden längs hela högersidan, av Svensk Golf utsett till ett av Sveriges bästa hål. Det kloka: spela långt fram på vänster sida och slipp andraslaget över vattnet. Det frestande: driver rakt över viken mot green. Ett hål med valmöjligheter.
holes.guideGreen: Large, broad, slightly kidney/oval shaped, drawn with a cross-hatched pale texture. Its long axis lies roughly across the line of play (left-to-right, angled a little from lower-left to upper-right), so it presents a wide but shallow target. Surrounded by a wide collar of fringe/apron; a bunker guards it short-left and the lake presses hard against its right and right-rear edge. No tiering or slope shading is legible at this resolution, and I can see no red or yellow pin dot on the green itself. The two coloured dots visible (a red one at about 0.55 and a yellow one at about 0.37, both mid-fairway) carry tiny numbers and read as distance markers, not pin positions. A "Next Tee" flag sits beyond the green to the left.
holes.guideTrees: A continuous, dense treeline (mostly conifers with some broadleaf/birch) runs down the ENTIRE left side, from level with the back tee all the way past the green, sitting on a strip of brown waste/rough just off the left rough — it is closest in around 0.1–0.3 near the tees and again around 0.6–0.8. More trees stand behind and left-behind the green at the top of the plan. The right side has no trees at all; it is water. Net effect is a corridor squeezed between forest left and lake right, tightest through the middle third.
holes.shape: short par 4 hugging the shore - fjord all down the right, fairway bends left then turns sharply right to a green on a point with a bunker left
holes.orientation: Tee at the BOTTOM of the plan (slightly right of centre), green at the TOP — play runs up the image. The six pale tee rectangles are stacked bottom-right: 40 and 48 on a small forward pad to the left, 55/58/61 on a larger pad, and 65 (back tee) lowest and furthest down the peninsula. A compass rose sits top-left of the plan; its letters are small and rotated, but reading clockwise it goes E (upper-left), S (upper-right), W (lower-right), N (lower-left) — so north points toward the LOWER-LEFT of the frame and the hole plays roughly southeast. The compass is small and low-contrast, so treat that bearing as approximate.

holes.name: Favoritklubban
holes.note: Ett förhållandevis enkelt par 4, svagt uppför. Placera utslaget så att du kan slå in på green med en favoritklubba – ett halvslag är svårare än ett fullt, och greenen är omgiven av fem bunkrar som gärna tar emot ett duffat inspel.
holes.guideGreen: A fairly large kidney/oval green with a distinct notch bitten out of its right side. The long axis runs roughly from front-left to back-right, i.e. broadly along the line of play but canted, so it presents a fair depth to an approach. It is drawn as a pale cross-hatched patch inside a ring of fringe and a surrounding apron, sitting slightly right of the fairway centre line. Five bunkers ring it (two small round ones left, a crescent short-left, a crescent short-right and a small round one right). No pin dot is visible on the green itself; the only red oval on the plan lies out in the middle of the striped fairway at about 0.67, which reads as an aiming/distance marker rather than a pin. No tiering or slope shading is legible at this resolution.
holes.guideTrees: A continuous, dense deciduous treeline (birch and similar) presses in hard along the entire right side, from behind the tees all the way past the green, sitting between the fairway and the right-hand stream/OB line and squeezing the corridor from about 0.15 to 0.6 where the rough on the right is widest. A short row of conifers stands on the left at roughly 0.45-0.50, just beyond the crossing ditch. Otherwise the left side is open — mown ground, the two ponds and the walk to the next tee — and the area immediately around the green is clear of trees apart from the right-hand belt.
holes.shape: short straight par 4; ponds down the left, thick pine belt down the right, green ringed by bunkers by the clubhouse
holes.orientation: Standard layout: the six tee boxes sit at the bottom of the plan (the 65 tee lowest and slightly right, then 58/61, 55, an unlabelled box, and 40/48 stepping up the left-centre) and the green is in the upper third, a little right of centre. Play therefore runs up the image. The compass rose at upper left is rotated: N points to the LEFT edge of the frame, E to the top, S to the right, W to the bottom — so the hole plays roughly due EAST from tee to green, with north off the player's left.

holes.name: Kanondrive
holes.note: Första av två tuffa avslutningshål. Ett tvärgående dike på fairways vänstra sida drar till sig bollar – når driven inte förbi, lägg upp före vattnet. Den ondulerade greenen rullar av mot vattenhindret till vänster eller bunkern till höger. Par kräver en riktig kanondrive.
holes.guideGreen: A single fairly large green sitting at the top-left of the plan, drawn as a bright cross-hatched patch roughly square/rounded - close to as wide as it is deep, with its long axis lying slightly across (perpendicular to) the line of play and its rear-left shoulder pushed toward the lake. It sits inside a much larger pale mown apron/fringe that extends forward and right of the putting surface. Water is immediately left and short-left; the small bunker sits just right of centre, at the same depth as the green centre. No tiering, contour lines or slope arrows are drawn, and NO pin dot is visible on the putting surface - the red dot (about 0.76) and yellow dot (about 0.64) lie out in the fairway and are distance markers (they compute to roughly 100 m and 150 m remaining), as does the small white/grey marker at about 0.52 (roughly 200 m).
holes.guideTrees: A continuous dense treeline runs the entire RIGHT side of the hole from the tees to behind the green, and it presses in noticeably around 0.45-0.60, where a finger of trees and brown rough juts into the right side of the corridor and squeezes the fairway toward the lake side. Trees also close off the top of the plan behind the green. On the LEFT the tree cover is much sparser: a few scattered specimen trees in the left rough around 0.45-0.60 near the feeder brook, and one or two by the 48 tee. Between about 0.65 and 0.95 the left side is open water rather than trees, so the pinch is water-left / trees-right.
holes.shape: long straight par 4 with a big lake down the entire left side of the approach and green; open heath right
holes.orientation: Standard layout: the six tee boxes are at the BOTTOM of the plan (65 back tee lowest-left, then 61 to its right, 55 and 58 above them, 48 above those, and the forward 40 tee pushed well up the fairway at roughly a third of the hole). The green is at the TOP of the plan, set left of centre. Play therefore runs up the image. The compass rose sits at the left edge, level with the lake: its N arrow points to the upper-RIGHT of the frame (W upper-left, S lower-left, E lower-right), i.e. north is roughly 45 degrees clockwise from "up the image", so the hole plays approximately north-west.

holes.name: Över bäcken hem
holes.note: Långt par 5 i motlut upp mot klubbhuset, med gott om plats för driven. De flesta lägger andraslaget så nära bäcken som möjligt; den som går för green ska veta att fairway smalnar av rejält på andra sidan. Nivåskillnaden blir ännu tydligare efter diket vid inspelet – välj klubba för tredjeslaget med omsorg.
holes.guideGreen: A pale cream, rounded pear/kidney shape sitting at the top of the plan, ringed by a distinct fringe/collar. It is a little wider than it is deep, with its long axis running roughly across the line of play (front-left to back-right), and it has a clear notch or waist bitten out of its left side, so the front-left is pinched while the back half is fuller. A striped approach apron funnels into it from the front/front-left. No pin dot (red or yellow) is discernible on the green in this screenshot, and no tiering or slope shading can be read at this resolution.
holes.guideTrees: A heavy, continuous treeline runs down the LEFT from about mid-hole (0.55) all the way back past the tees, pressing right up to the edge of the left rough and squeezing the drive corridor from the left. Trees also line the RIGHT in the tee-to-fairway stretch, and a scattered belt of trees sits in and around the crossing ditch at roughly 0.24-0.32 — that is the narrowest point of the corridor, with timber on both sides. Further back, trees flank the 55/58/61/65 tees on both sides, making the tee shot the most enclosed part of the hole. The mid and upper fairway is comparatively open, with only the ravine's wooded strip on the left; a single specimen tree stands in the right rough just short and right of the green (about 0.97).
holes.shape: long straight par 5 uphill to the clubhouse; ponds right of the corridor at 100-150, scattered fairway bunkers
holes.orientation: Standard LiveCaddie layout, verified: the six tee rectangles (65, 61, 58, 55, 48, 40) are stacked at the BOTTOM of the plan and the green is at the TOP, so play runs up the image. The 65 (back) tee sits bottom-centre-left, the green is top-centre. The compass rose sits in the upper right of the plan; its N arrow points to the LOWER-LEFT of the frame (E upper-left, S upper-right, W lower-right), so "up the image" corresponds roughly to SOUTHEAST — the hole plays broadly south-east.
